svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap: disc 124 x 8, printed flat. A 6 mm hole at the centre for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: probe tube; three 5.5 mm holes on the 84 mm circle (as the plates).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M5 heat-set inserts in the top face, 30 each side of centre on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the line along the cross arm: 6.8 mm holes, 8 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Probe tube: cut 76 mm of 6 mm aluminium tube; deburr inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Thread the 4-core probe lead up through it; glue the SHT45 board to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower end with neutral-cure silicone, sensor facing down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the tube goes up through the cap and the arm's 8 mm hole; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board then hangs 57 mm below the cap, in the middle of the stack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A bead of silicone holds the tube in the cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board does not touch any plate (19 mm clear).
